summary: All 27 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Across 14,269 paired effects, Pearson was 0.746223, Spearman was 0.572998, and 68.93% agreed in direction. Neither concordance route passed. Matching the heatmap columns to the deposited matrix placed K10_S88 in the plotted KO group and W15_S83 in WT. The corrected proposal retains needs_author_contact, documents tissue and strain conflicts, and clarifies that 23 of the 44 IDs dropped by the registered symbol map have an author symbol. [Figure 7B](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC10480059.1/gr7.jpg)
openIssues: K10_S88 maps to SRR24182099, whose sample is labeled WT10/WT. Its animal genotype and condition in the fitted model still require confirmation.
W15_S83 has no matching original FASTQ name among the nine project runs. Its animal and raw library remain unidentified.

All nine GEO records specify hypothalamus but describe frozen perigonadal adipose tissue in the protocol. GEO lists C57b/6J, while the paper describes a CD-1 KO line. The sequenced tissue and genetic background require confirmation. [GEO sample](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSM7178034) · [Study methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10480059/)
The checkout’s QC summary reports 422 significant genes. The registered table, browser track and live QC summary agree on 43 at FDR < 0.05.
